capabilities: Wrap selected lines in a callout of a chosen type
Remove callout syntax from selected lines
Switch an existing callout to a different type
Retain custom titles when wrapping or removing callouts
Sync custom callout types with Callout Manager
extras: The author notes availability for feedback may be limited because this is a side project.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin to instantly add, switch, or remove callouts in your notes.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in commands or hotkeys for adding, removing, or switching callouts, so users must type the syntax by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin automatically integrates with the Callout Manager plugin, if you have it installed

summary: Command-based tool that wraps lines in callouts, removes callout syntax, and switches callout types, with a separate command per callout type.
